P.expected_type: ∀ (K : Type*) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type*) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (rho : LR.L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x : LR.L) (y : LR.L) (h : LR.L) (v : V) (h_H001 : Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ l ∧ l < (p : ℤ)) (h_H002 : LR.ComplexHyp l rho x y h) (h_H003 : v ≠ 0 ∧ rho x v = 0 ∧ rho h v = (l : ℂ) • v) (h_H004 : LR.Admissible rho x y M), LR.Target K M rho x y h

correspondence.explanation: All parameters and H001–H004 are retained: arbitrary characteristic-p field K, 0≤l<p, the complex sl₂ module and Chevalley triple, chosen highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissible lattice. ComplexHyp uses trace-zero 2×2 complex matrices, the spanning Chevalley triple, representation law, dimension l.toNat+1, nontriviality, irreducibility and existence of a highest-weight vector; H001 identifies l.toNat with the nonnegative integer l. Admissible records coincident integer/complex bases and preservation by every divided power. U_Z-stability implies this generator preservation; conversely preservation extends to its generated unital integer algebra by closure under addition, integer scalars, composition and identity. Submodule ℤ V represents the additive subgroup. The tensor flip identifies VK=K⊗ℤM with the source M⊗ℤK, preserving the K action, and similarly identifies K⊗ℤLZ with the source Lie algebra. Target asserts nontriviality and produces Action, whose onM_spec, red_spec, red_lie, Lift and gen_spec specify exactly the induced lattice Lie action and its three generators. These formulas uniquely determine the operators on pure tensors and hence everywhere. Thus Target yields the source assertion for the canonical action; conversely that assertion together with the constructed action gives Target. Nontriviality is equivalent to a nonzero vector, and bottom/top submodules mean zero/the whole space. Stability under the generators is equivalent to stability under their scalar-extended integer span, by linearity and closure of subspaces under linear combinations. T007/T010 construct Action; T020/T021 check the tensor conversions actually used, and T029 proves Target using the same action and transported basis from T025. No algebraic closure or separation of reduced weights is assumed, including l=0 and p=2.

proof_patches.T029:
run_tac do
  let profile : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
    let env ← Lean.getEnv
    if !(env.contains `Translation.T001) then return
    let emit (s : String) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
      let out ← IO.getStdout
      out.putStrLn ("ASSEMBLY_PROFILE " ++ s)
      out.flush
    let steps ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let started ← IO.mkRef (← IO.monoMsNow)
    let rec uses (fuel : Nat) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
      match fuel with
      | 0 => throwError "diagnostic expression depth"
      | n+1 =>
        let k ← steps.get
        steps.set (k+1)
        if k % 1024 == 0 then
          if (← IO.monoMsNow) - (← started.get) > 2000 then
            throwError "diagnostic traversal exceeded two seconds"
        match e with
        | .const name _ =>
          let ci ← Lean.getConstInfo name
          discard <| Lean.Meta.isProp ci.type
        | .app .. =>
          let fn := e.getAppFn
          uses n fn
          let mut type ← Lean.Meta.inferType fn
          for arg in e.getAppArgs do
            if !type.isForall then type ← Lean.Meta.whnf type
            match type with
            | .forallE _ _ body _ =>
              uses n arg
              type := body.instantiate1 arg
            | _ => throwError "diagnostic application binder"
        | .lam name type body bi | .forallE name type body bi =>
          uses n type
          Lean.Meta.withLocalDecl name bi type fun x => uses n (body.instantiate1 x)
        | .letE name type value body _ =>
          uses n type
          uses n value
          Lean.Meta.withLetDecl name type value fun x => uses n (body.instantiate1 x)
        | .mdata _ value | .proj _ _ value => uses n value
        | _ => pure ()
    let mut pending : Array Lean.Name := #[`Translation.T028, `Translation.T027, `Translation.T026,
      `Translation.T025, `Translation.T024, `Translation.T023, `Translation.T022, `Translation.T021,
      `Translation.T020, `Translation.T019, `Translation.T018, `Translation.T017, `Translation.T016,
      `Translation.T015, `Translation.T014, `Translation.T013, `Translation.T012, `Translation.T011,
      `Translation.T010, `Translation.T009, `Translation.T008, `Translation.T007, `Translation.T006,
      `Translation.T005, `Translation.T004, `Translation.T003, `Translation.T002, `Translation.T001]
    let mut seen : Lean.NameSet := {}
    let mut count := 0
    while !pending.isEmpty && count < 150 do
      let name := pending.back!
      pending := pending.pop
      if seen.contains name then continue
      seen := seen.insert name
      count := count+1
      let ci ← Lean.getConstInfo name
      let imported := env.isImportedConst name
      emit s!"BEGIN {name} imported={imported}"
      let start ← IO.monoMsNow
      if !imported then
        if let some value := ci.value? (allowOpaque := true) then
          steps.set 0
          started.set start
          try
            uses 10000 value
            emit s!"USES {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-start} nodes={← steps.get}"
          catch _ =>
            emit s!"USES_LIMIT {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-start} nodes={← steps.get}"
      let t ← IO.monoMsNow
      let s ← Lean.withOptions (fun o => (o.setBool `pp.all true).setBool `pp.universes true) do
        return (← Lean.Meta.ppExpr ci.type).pretty
      emit s!"TYPE {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-t} chars={s.length}"
      let t ← IO.monoMsNow
      discard <| Lean.collectAxioms name
      emit s!"AXIOMS {name} ms={(← IO.monoMsNow)-t}"
      if !imported then
        pending := pending ++ ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.toArray
        if let .inductInfo val := ci then pending := pending ++ val.ctors.toArray
    throwError "ASSEMBLY_PROFILE_COMPLETE: temporary diagnostic, not a proof submission"
  profile
